text: dsh-pixel-office 是适用于 DSH Web 客户端的像素办公室面板，通过侧边栏入口将工作区、会话和团队成员组织成楼宇、楼层与办公室。它订阅宿主提供的工作区及会话快照，显示运行状态、标题和团队信息，并提供整栋楼、工作区和会话房间三层视图。用户可点击楼层、办公室或成员进入相应工作区或会话，也可切换昼夜显示。适合希望直观看到多个工作区及智能体会话活动的 DSH 用户；需使用 DSH Web UI 和插件支持，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-pixel-office adds a pixel-art panel to DSH Web. It maps workspaces to buildings and sessions to offices, showing activity and teams from host snapshots. Browse three levels and click through to workspaces or sessions; switch day/night. Requires DSH Web UI and plugin support; no API key.
想用一张像素风总览图查看各个 DSH 工作区和正在运行的会话。
能不能从工作区视图点进具体会话，并看见团队成员分布？
I want a visual dashboard that shows which DSH sessions and workspaces are active.
dsh-pixel-office 的功能「工作区与会话楼宇图」：把每个工作区绘成一栋楼、会话绘成楼层办公室，并从实时快照更新运行状态和团队信息。点击楼层或办公室可进入更细视图。
dsh-pixel-office 的功能「昼夜显示切换」：在面板顶部或 DSH 通用设置选择自动、白天或夜间模式；偏好保存在浏览器中，自动模式按本地时间更新场景。
dsh-pixel-office 会读取宿主提供的会话与工作区快照，并将昼夜偏好保存到浏览器 localStorage 的 dsh.pixel-office.display.v1 键。

dsh-pixel-office README · Pixel Office · dsh-pixel-office：A fixed-pixel office tower for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: all of your sessions become one building you can watch and click through.

> One tower = all workspaces · one floor = one workspace · one office on a floor = one session (one agent team)
> **A lit floor means work in progress.**

dsh-pixel-office README · Features：- **Sidebar entry next to your other panels** — a pixel tower icon opens the office page.
- **Three zoom levels**: the whole tower (all workspaces) → one workspace floor (all of its offices) → one session room (the team). Breadcrumbs and `Esc` walk back up.
- **Live data, no refresh**: subscribes to the host's `sessions.list` / `workspaces.list` snapshots, so running state, titles, team size, todo progress and recent work update in place.
- **Lights mean work**: floor status strips, office windows and desk lamps follow each session's `running` flag; day/night is automatic (07:00–19:00 is day) or switchable.
- **Agent Teams aware**: the `agentTeam` projection (lead + teammates) is used when present; when a projection is missing the roster is derived from the session graph (`parentId` children), so future orchestrators such as Super-agent workers show up as staff too. The main session gets the private office, teammates and subagents sit in the open office.
- **Click-through**: click a floor → workspace, click an office → room, click a character → open that session; `Esc` goes up one level.
- **Fixed-pixel world**: every object has a constant pixel s

dsh-pixel-office README · Install：Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.3** or newer with the Web UI and plugin support.

1. **From the DSH Plugin Market** (after the catalog listing is merged): Plugins → Discover, search **Pixel Office**, install, then refresh the window once.
2. **From this repository** (source install):

```sh
   git clone https://github.com/Thunderunruly/agent-office.git
   ```

then install the absolute folder through DSH's plugin manager:

```text
   install_bundle <path-to-agent-office>
   ```

dsh-pixel-office README · Install：3. **Local development folder**: the same `install_bundle <absolute path>` works on a checkout you edit; rebuild `client.js` with `node scripts/build.mjs` and refresh the window.

After installation, refresh the DSH window once so the client bundle enters the boot graph. Later client changes hot-reload in place.

dsh-pixel-office README · Usage：1. Click the tower icon in the left sidebar.
2. In the **All view**, each floor is a workspace; lit offices on that floor are working sessions. Click a floor to enter it.
3. In the **workspace view**, each glass office is a session: the lead's big desk plus the team's workstations. Click an office to enter the room.
4. In the **session room**, the lead sits in the private office on the right; teammates and subagents work in the open office. Click anyone to open that session.
5. Use the day/night switch at the top, or Settings → General → **Pixel office display**; the wheel / arrow keys / the pixel pager on the elevator shaft flip pages when the view has more floors or offices than fit.

dsh-pixel-office README · How it works：- `index.js` — Host entry; the current version only keeps the bundle shape stable for future Super-agent adapters.
- `client.js` — the browser module: subscribes to the session/workspace snapshots, folds them into an `OfficeModel` (workspace → floors → staff), then paints three fixed-pixel scenes on one canvas (responsive only in how much is visible). React owns the page chrome; the canvas owns the world.
- `cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch that inserts the plugin row.

dsh-pixel-office README · How it works：No build system: `scripts/build.mjs` concatenates the owned sources in `src/` into the single-file Client module. `scripts/verify.mjs` runs the model and all scenes offline over several viewports, pages and day/night states.

dsh-pixel-office README · Privacy：- Only reads session metadata the host already exposes to Client plugins (titles, running state, update time, cwd, parent session, team projection, and the compact work/todo projection).
- Never reads session log files, never writes session logs, makes no network requests and carries no telemetry.
- One `localStorage` key: `dsh.pixel-office.display.v1` (day/night preference).
dsh-pixel-office README · Super-agent compatibility：The office models "who is working" as a generic session graph instead of hard-coding one multi-agent implementation:

dsh-pixel-office README · Known limitations：- The open office shows up to 6 seats; extra members appear as a “more members” chip.
- Read-only visualization: no approving permissions or sending messages from inside the room.
- Below ~700 logical pixels of width the fixed room core is cropped symmetrically (the boss office and all desks stay whole; outer wall decoration is trimmed).
- Visual verification happens against a running DSH page; the plugin ships no preview page of its own.

dsh-pixel-office README · Development：```powershell
cd agent-office
node scripts/build.mjs --check   # syntax / manifest / policy checks
node scripts/verify.mjs          # offline model + scene contract verification
node scripts/build.mjs           # emit client.js (refresh the DSH window afterwards)

Source layout and the frozen scene contracts are documented in [docs/SPEC.md](docs/SPEC.md). The release checklist (git tag, plugin-market PR, optional npm publish) is in [docs/RELEASING.md](docs/RELEASING.md).

dsh-pixel-office README · 功能：- **左侧栏入口**：与会话看板等项目并列的像素楼图标，点开即是办公室。
- **三种视图**：整栋楼（全部工作区）→ 工作区楼层平面（该层所有办公室）→ 会话房间（一个团队）。面包屑与 `Esc` 都能逐层返回。
- **活数据、不刷新**：订阅宿主的 `sessions.list` / `workspaces.list` 快照，运行状态、标题、团队人数、待办进度、最近工作实时更新。
- **亮灯即工作中**：楼层状态条、办公室窗户、桌面台灯都跟随 `running`；昼夜按本地时间 07:00–19:00 自动切换，也能手动锁定。
- **懂 Agent Teams**：优先使用 `agentTeam` 投影（lead + teammates）；投影缺席时从会话图（`parentId` 子会话）兜底推导员工。主会话坐老板办公室，团队成员与子代理坐开放办公区。Super-agent 等未来编排器的 Worker 会话同样按会话图显示，不需要改画布。
- **点击即导航**：点楼层进工作区，点办公室进房间，点房间里的角色直接打开那个会话；`Esc` 返回上一层。
- **固定像素世界**：每个物件尺寸固定（楼层 32px、楼宽 420、办公室 210×150、房间核心 760×488），调整窗口大小是"露出更多/更少"，不会把画面拉大压扁；一屏放不下时用电梯井上的像素翻页箭头按页翻。
- **宿主原生界面**：页面外壳优先使用宿主的 `Button` / `SegmentedControl` / `Modal` / `Tooltip`（拿不到时自动回退到内置实现），深浅色主题与未来的 DSH 皮肤都能跟随。

dsh-pixel-office README · 安装：需要 DSH **0.2.1-rc.3** 或更新版本（带 Web UI 与插件支持）。

1. **从 DSH 插件市场安装**（目录收录合并后）：插件 → 发现（Discover）→ 搜索 **像素办公室 / Pixel Office** → 安装，然后刷新一次窗口。
2. **从本仓库安装**（源码方式）：

```sh
   git clone https://github.com/Thunderunruly/agent-office.git
   ```

然后在 DSH 插件管理器里安装这个绝对路径：

```text
   install_bundle <path-to-agent-office>
   ```

3. **本地开发目录**：同一套 `install_bundle <绝对路径>` 也适用于你正在改的 checkout；改完源码运行 `node scripts/build.mjs` 生成 `client.js`，刷新 DSH 窗口即可。

安装后需要刷新一次 DSH 窗口，让客户端 bundle 进入启动图；之后的客户端改动支持热加载。

dsh-pixel-office README · 使用：1. 点左侧栏的像素楼图标。
2. **全部视图**：每层是一个工作区，层里亮着的小办公室是工作中的会话。点楼层进入。
3. **工作区视图**：每间玻璃办公室是一个会话（老板大桌 + 团队工位）。点办公室进入房间。
4. **会话房间**：右侧老板办公室是主会话，左侧开放办公区是团队成员与子代理。点任意角色直接打开对应会话。
5. 顶部可切昼夜（或 设置 → 通用 → 像素办公室显示）；滚轮 / ↑↓ / 电梯井上的像素翻页箭头按页翻。

dsh-pixel-office README · 实现：一个 bundle 包含宿主端与客户端两半：

- `index.js` — 宿主入口，目前只保持 bundle 形态稳定，方便未来接 Super-agent 适配器。
- `client.js` — 浏览器模块：订阅会话/工作区快照，折叠成 `OfficeModel`（工作区 → 楼层 → 员工），再用一块 canvas 画三种固定像素场景（只响应"可见范围"，不缩放画面）。React 负责页面外壳，canvas 负责世界。
- `cordis.patch.yml` — 把插件行插入 profile 的 bundle patch。

没有构建系统：`scripts/build.mjs` 把 `src/` 里按所有权拆分的源码拼成单文件 Client 模块；`scripts/verify.mjs` 离线跑模型与全部场景的视口/分页/昼夜契约校验。

dsh-pixel-office README · 隐私：- 只读取宿主本来就会暴露给 Client 插件的会话元数据（标题、运行状态、更新时间、工作目录、父会话、团队投影、看板投影里的工作/待办摘要）。
- 不读会话日志文件、不写会话日志、不发网络请求、没有遥测。
- 只使用一个 `localStorage` 键：`dsh.pixel-office.display.v1`（昼夜偏好）。

dsh-pixel-office README · Super-agent 兼容：办公室把"谁在干活"抽象成通用会话图，而不是写死某一种多智能体实现：

- 团队领导（Agent Teams 的 `lead`，未来的 `router` / `captain` / `boss`）坐老板办公室；
- 团队投影成员，或 `parentId` 指向该会话的子会话（子代理、Super-agent 的 Worker）坐开放办公区工位；
- 角色归一与员工推导集中在 `src/model.js`，宿主以后给出新的团队投影/角色字段时只改这一处；画布与 UI 只消费 `OfficeModel`，不感知数据来源。

dsh-pixel-office README · 已知限制：- 开放办公区最多 6 个工位，多出的成员显示为「还有 N 位成员」提示。
- 房间是只读可视化：暂不支持在画布里批准权限或给会话发消息。
- 窗口宽度低于约 700 逻辑像素时，固定房间核心会被对称裁切（老板办公室和全部工位保持完整，只裁外围装饰）。
- 视觉验证在真实 DSH 页面进行；插件本身不附带预览页。
